messages:
maya: Quick share — results from last night's burst-pacing + heterogeneous GPU quant bringup across us-west / us-east / eu-west. TL;DR: burst pacing reduces p99 on A100 by ~12% but increases p99 on g4s by ~8%. q4_0 quant gave ~2% Delta-F1 on our pronoun/Winograd-like eval. Full data + charts: https://go.redwood/bench/2105-burst (dashboard)

aj: Can you paste the exact config you ran? batch_window / max_batch_tokens / fairshare?

maya: config snippet:
```
batch_window_ms: 6
max_batch_tokens: 4096
fairshare_decay_ms: 30000
burst_pacing: true
kernel_policy: auto_pref_hybrid
quant_profile: q4_0
```

bench-bot: nightly-run summary — us-west (A100): throughput=125 tok/s, p50=18ms, p95=82ms, p99=120ms; eu-west (g4): throughput=48 tok/s, p50=45ms, p95=240ms, p99=330ms; delta-vs-baseline: A100 p99 -12%, g4 p99 +8%.

diego: Noted. Kernel choices on g4 were falling back to slower matmul kernels around seq_len>1024. Can we try kernel_policy: prefer_matmul_fast? That might trim the tail.

maya: good call — forcing prefer_matmul_fast on g4 reduced p99 by ~45ms in a quick replay. I'll include that in the next sweep.

sophia: about q4_0: we saw a small but consistent regression on pronoun-resolution slices. Repro steps: run eval/priorset/refs against the onnx-qa harness and compare logits/top-5 diffs. I recommend tagging the eu-west canary as 'no-quant' until we investigate root cause.

aj: Agree. For Dedicated A100 pools we can keep q4_0, but pin g4s to fp16 for now. Also think about per-GPU batch_window_ms overrides for heterogeneous clusters — global window is suboptimal.

maya: Plan: 1) revert canary in eu-west to fp16; 2) launch per-gpu batch_window sweep (6, 12, 20ms) on hetero nodes; 3) force_matmul on g4 for the sweep; 4) run pronoun/long-context eval slice. Will post updated dashboard when done.

sophia: :eyes: assigning me to the pronoun eval. I'll run the diff harness and open a tiny PR with failing examples if any.

bench-bot: sweep queued. ETA ~3h. Will post results to the dashboard and ping #eng-ml when complete. :robot_face: 

aj: thanks — please add the exact config + rollback steps to the rollout doc so oncall can revert quickly.

maya: added rollout doc: https://go.redwood/rollouts/2105-burst-pacing

diego: also capture kernel traces (set RUNTIME_KTRACE=1) for the g4 p99 runs, that'll help kernel team triage.

maya: will do. thx all :thumbsup:
